help: Images from a local ComfyUI server (https://www.comfy.org).
It needs no API key and runs on your own GPU.
um comfy status                                   # is ComfyUI up? which checkpoints can it load?
um comfy image "a rusty scrap drone enemy, side view, 16-bit pixel art" --name drone
um comfy image "a red health potion" --sprite     # plain background, then cut out locally (um sprite cutout)
um comfy image "mossy dungeon wall" --checkpoint sd_xl_base_1.0.safetensors --size 1024x1024 --steps 30
um comfy run my_workflow.json --set 6.text="a blue mana potion" --set 3.seed:=42 --name potion
Start ComfyUI first. It listens on http://127.0.0.1:8188.
Use --url or COMFYUI_URL for another address.
`image` runs the default text-to-image graph of ComfyUI (checkpoint, two prompts, KSampler, VAE decode).
This graph fits SD 1.5 and SDXL checkpoints.
Without --checkpoint, it takes the first checkpoint that the server lists.
For anything else (Flux, img2img, ControlNet, LoRAs), build the graph in ComfyUI.
Save it with Export (API), and run it with `um comfy run`.
--set NODE.INPUT=value changes a node input first.
NODE is the node id or its title, and := takes JSON (numbers, true/false).
Each call adds a line to <out>/comfy_manifest.jsonl (workflow, seed, files).
With this line, you can trace an image and make it again.

messages.noServer: no ComfyUI at {base} ({err}). Start it (python main.py in the ComfyUI folder), or pass --url or set COMFYUI_URL
messages.notQueued: ComfyUI did not queue the workflow: {detail}
messages.timeout: ComfyUI did not finish in {s} s (prompt {id}). It is still queued or running
messages.nothing: the workflow finished but saved nothing: add a SaveImage node (prompt {id})
messages.uiFormat: {file} is a UI workflow. In ComfyUI, save it with Export (API) and run that file
messages.notApi: {file} is not an API-format workflow (a JSON object of nodes, each with class_type and inputs)
messages.noCheckpoints: ComfyUI lists no checkpoints: put one in ComfyUI/models/checkpoints, or run a workflow with `um comfy run`

status.help: is ComfyUI running, and which checkpoints can it load

image.help: text to image with the default graph of ComfyUI (SD 1.5 and SDXL checkpoints)

timeout.help: seconds to wait for the result

checkpoint.help: checkpoint file name (default: the first one that the server lists)

size.help: WxH (default 1024x1024 for a checkpoint name that looks like SDXL, else 512x512)

sprite.help: one sprite on a plain background, then a local cutout

run.help: run a workflow saved with Export (API), with --set overrides

timeout.help: seconds to wait for the result

set.help: NODE.INPUT=V changes a node input (repeatable, := for JSON)

defaults.negative: blurry, low quality, jpeg artifacts, watermark, text, signature
